questions.q_en: In a quadrilateral APQR, the side QR is extended to S such that RS = PR. IfQPS = 110° and PRQ =70°, then the value of PQR is:
questions.q_hi: चतुर्भुज APQR में, भुजा QR को S तक इस प्रकार बढ़ाया गया है कि RS = PR है। यदि QPS = 110° और PRQ = 70° है, तो PQR का मान क्या है?
options_en: 50°
40°
35°
45°
questions.solution_en:
∠RSP = ∠SPR [RS = PR]
∠RSP + ∠SPR = ∠PRQ [exterior angle property]
2x = 70 ̊
x =35 ̊
So, ∠QPR = 110 ̊ - 35 ̊
= 75 ̊
In △PQR
∠PQR = 180 ̊ - [75 ̊ + 70 ̊]
= 180 ̊ - 145 ̊
∠PQR = 35 ̊
questions.solution_hi:
∠RSP = ∠SPR [RS = PR]
∠RSP + ∠SPR = ∠PRQ [बाहरी कोण संपत्ति]
2x = 70 ̊
x =35 ̊
अतः, ∠QPR = 110 ̊ -35 ̊
= 75 ̊
△PQR में
∠PQR = 180 ̊ - [75 ̊ + 70 ̊]
= 180 ̊ - 145 ̊
∠PQR = 35 ̊

questions.q_en: The ratio of the diameters of two spheres is given as 1:4. The larger sphere is melted and 125 identical spheres are made out of the molten material. The smaller sphere is melted and 27 identical spheres are made out of the molten material. If the ratio of the volume of each of the 125 identical spheres to the volume of each of the 27 identical spheres is given as 1 : m, what is the value of m?

Volume of sphere = πr³
Let the radius of 125 identical spheres be r₁.
π[4]³ = 125 × π[r₁]³
= r₁
Similarly, let the radius of 27 identical spheres be r₂.
π[1]³ = 27 × π[r₂]³
= r₂
Required ratio: : = 1 : m
= 1 : m
m =

questions.q_en: Let x be the least number between 56,000 and 60,000 which when divided by 40, 45, 50 and 55 leaves a remainder of 23 in each case. What is the sum of the digits of x?
questions.q_hi: मान लीजिए x, 56,000 और 60,000 के बीच सबसे छोटी संख्या है जिसे 40, 45, 50 और 55 से विभाजित करने पर प्रत्येक स्थिति में शेषफल 23 बचता है। x के अंकों का योग क्या है?
options_en: 23
21
26
18
questions.solution_en:
LCM of 40, 45, 50 and 55 = 19800
X = 19800×3 = 59400
Remainder will be = 59400+23=59423
5+9+4+2+3=23
questions.solution_hi:

X = 19800×3 = 59400

questions.q_en: A certain number of men can complete a piece of work in 6k days, where k is a natural number. By what percentage should the number of men be increased so that the work can be completed in 5k days?
questions.q_hi: कुछ निश्चित संख्या में पुरुष किसी कार्य को 6k दिनों में पूरा कर सकते हैं, जहाँ k एक प्राकृतिक संख्या है। पुरुषों की संख्या में कितने प्रतिशत की वृद्धि की जानी चाहिए ताकि कार्य 5k दिनों में पूरा हो सके?
options_en: 10%
20%
25%
questions.solution_en:
[5K × M] : [6K × M]= 5 ∶ 6
So, the number of persons increased by = ×100 = 20%
questions.solution_hi:
[5K × M] : [6K × M]= 5 ∶ 6
इसलिए, व्यक्तियों की संख्या में वृद्धि = ×100 = 20%

questions.q_en: A certain sum is deposited for 4 years at a rate of 10% per annum on compound interest compounded annually. The difference between the interest at the end of 2 years and that at the end of 4 years is ₹5,082. Find the sum [in ₹].
questions.q_hi: एक निश्चित राशि 4 वर्षों के लिए 10% प्रति वर्ष की दर से वार्षिक रूप से संयोजित चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज पर जमा की जाती है। 2 वर्ष के अंत में ब्याज और 4 वर्ष के अंत में ब्याज के बीच का अंतर ₹5,082 है। राशि [₹ में] ज्ञात कीजिए।
options_en: 20,000
25,500
50,820
10,164
questions.solution_en:
Let the principal be 100
Effective rate of 2 years and 4 years at the rate of 10% is 21% and 46.41% respectively
Difference = 46.41% - 21% = 25.41%
Sum = ×100 = ₹20,000
questions.solution_hi:
मान लीजिए मूलधन 100 है
10% की दर से 2 वर्ष और 4 वर्ष की प्रभावी दर क्रमश: 21% और 46.41% है
अंतर = 46.41% - 21% = 25.41%
योग = ×100 = ₹20,000
